title: IELTS Speaking Part 3: Education — Simple Present
titleVi: IELTS Speaking Part 3: Giáo dục — Thì Hiện Tại Đơn

speakingCueCard.prompt: Do you think homework is important for students?

questionPrompt: Read the speaking response below. Select every grammar error you notice by highlighting it. You may also type the correct version in the box that appears.
questionPromptVi: Đọc đoạn văn dưới đây. Chọn mỗi lỗi ngữ pháp bạn phát hiện bằng cách bôi đen. Bạn có thể gõ bản sửa đúng vào ô hiện ra.
passageText: Honestly, I believe homework play a really important role in education, because it helps students review what they learn in class. Let me explain what I mean: when a student goes home and practises the lesson again, the information stay in their memory much longer. Of course, I understand that too much homework can cause stress, and nobody want that. However, without any homework at all, I think most students would simply forget everything by the next morning. So in my opinion, a reasonable amount of homework is actually beneficial for everyone. That is why I always encourage my younger siblings to finish their assignments.

errors.explanation: 'Homework' is an uncountable singular noun — the verb requires -s: 'plays'.
errors.explanationVi: 'Homework' là danh từ không đếm được số ít — động từ cần -s: 'plays'.

errors.errorText: the information stay in their memory
errors.correctText: the information stays in their memory
acceptedAnswers: the information stays in their memory
errors.explanation: 'The information' is uncountable singular — use 'stays', not 'stay'.
errors.explanationVi: 'The information' là danh từ không đếm được số ít — dùng 'stays', không phải 'stay'.

errors.explanation: 'Nobody' is grammatically singular — it takes 'wants', not 'want'. Indefinite pronouns like nobody, everybody, someone always take singular verbs.
errors.explanationVi: 'Nobody' về ngữ pháp là số ít — dùng 'wants', không phải 'want'. Đại từ bất định như nobody, everybody, someone luôn đi với động từ số ít.

falseAlarmZones.text: a student goes home and practises
falseAlarmZones.hint: 'Goes' and 'practises' are both correct — 'a student' is singular, so both verbs correctly take -s/-es.

collocations.sourceInPassage: review what they learn in class
collocations.translation: ôn lại những gì học trên lớp
collocations.exampleSentence: Good students always review what they learn in class before the exam.
collocations.grammarNote: 'Review' dùng như động từ — không dùng 'revise' nếu nói về xem lại nội dung (British dùng 'revise' cũng đúng)

collocations.exampleSentence: Working long hours without breaks can cause stress and burnout.
collocations.grammarNote: 'Cause stress' — không dùng 'make stress' hay 'give stress'

collocations.exampleSentence: A reasonable amount of exercise each day keeps the body and mind healthy.
collocations.grammarNote: 'A reasonable amount of + uncountable noun' — không dùng 'a reasonable number of' cho danh từ không đếm được

collocations.exampleSentence: A healthy school lunch programme is beneficial for everyone involved.
collocations.grammarNote: 'Beneficial for + người' — không dùng 'beneficial to everyone' (cũng đúng nhưng ít tự nhiên)

generationMatrix.discourseSituation: A learner over-explaining their views on why homework matters
